one_sentence_story: Play the sound BA while showing lips saying GA on a screen. Almost all adults hear DA until they shut their eyes.
so_what_for_you: Face people in bright light and wear your glasses in loud rooms. Reading lips gives your ears a big boost.

jargon_map.plain: Hearing a third sound DA when your ears get BA and your eyes see GA.
jargon_map.analogy: Like mixing blue paint and yellow paint until you see green.

jargon_map.plain: Your brain blends sight and sound into one clear match before you know it.
jargon_map.analogy: Like two friends telling one shared story.

jargon_map.plain: A side brain hub that welds lip shapes and voice sounds together.
jargon_map.analogy: Like a sound desk mixing two tracks.

jargon_map.plain: Lips move a split second before sound waves leave the throat.
jargon_map.analogy: Like seeing lightning right before you hear thunder.
